name: voicebox
description: The open-source AI voice studio. Clone, dictate, create.
one_liner: An app that clones any voice from a short recording, turns typed text into speech in that voice, and lets you dictate into any other app, all running privately on your own computer.
buyer: An indie audiobook producer or podcast creator who wants professional narration without hiring a studio or paying per-minute cloud TTS fees.
business_use_cases: An audiobook producer narrates books in a licensed narrator's cloned voice at a fraction of studio recording cost.
A course creator turns written lesson scripts into narrated video lessons in their own voice without recording every take.
A dubbing studio offers foreign-language dubbing that preserves the original speaker's voice characteristics.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a 'narrate your book or course in your own voice' production service, billed per finished minute
License custom voice models to studios for recurring dubbing and narration work

steal_this: This weekend, clone your own voice, narrate a short public-domain story, and sell narration-as-a-service to local podcasters and course creators who hate hearing their own voice.
